title: Abba Toran
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman quotes [Shabbat 122b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.122b.2): Shmuel came to the house of Ravin Toran. [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Shabbat.122b.2.1) explains the name as a place-name. Hyman suggests that the man was tall and was called Toran, a mast, for that reason; compare [Bekhorot 45b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bekhorot.45b.8).[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Shabbat calls the house Beit Avi Toran. Hyman’s quotation has Ravin Toran and his heading has Abba Toran. Rashi takes Toran as a place-name. The Bekhorot comparison concerns height and is Hyman’s basis for suggesting a nickname meaning “mast.”
